text: The paper aims to compress text 5-10x per subtask with length limits of 128 to 384 tokens depending on height, and asks labelers to rate quality conditioned on length. The authors emphasise that for each subtask labelers judge the summary only with respect to the direct input to the model, not the part of the book that is the true summarisation target.
title: Labelers judge each subtask summary only against its direct input, conditioned on length
